nhook.text: Ten levels is not the limit. Meet the Infinity Bonus: no depth limit at all.

hi.text: Hi, I'm MTG, Your Digital Architect.

nshare.text: And Profit Share: one and a half percent of the strategy's profit on every open level, paid from the thirty percent share, never from client deposits.

ntop.text: It's a leadership bonus on top of the Profit Share, from level one, all the way down.

nbike.text: Think of a bicycle with gears. Your gear is your rate, set by your team's new volume each month: from one and a half percent at fifty thousand dollars, to seven and a half at forty million.

nmonth.text: And the trip meter resets every month: only that month's new volume counts, paid once a month.

nfifty.text: Rule one, the fifty percent rule: your strongest line counts for at most half. A bike needs two strong wheels.

ndiff.text: Rule two, the difference rule: if a partner in your line reaches their own rate, you earn the difference on their structure. Three percent minus their one and a half leaves you one and a half.

nrecap.text: So that's Infinity: your gear on your whole team, two strong wheels, and the difference rule.

n_turn2.text: Simple, right? Now it's your turn.

l_ifme.text: If I invited you, go to MTG tribe dot com slash jet up, and tap any Join Jet Up button.

every.text: Invited by someone else? Use their link. This video is for every team, so feel free to share it.

n_save.text: Save this video, so it's here when you need it.

n_share.text: Share it with someone who's ready to start.

n_we.text: We learn best when we teach others.

n_slog.text: It pays to pay attention, and take action.

o_fin.text: Quick reminder: none of this is financial advice.

o_thanks.text: Thank you for tuning in, and for every like, share, and comment.

o_massive.text: And thank yourself for taking massive action today to change your future!

o_best.text: I wish you nothing but the best, because YOU are the best.

o_see.text: See you on the next one.
